claim.statement: Parents parent_2, parent_3, and parent_9 all attempted polynomial or piecewise polynomial fits but failed at extrapolation. Since the fresh training window is [26,43], I fit four separate quadratic segments directly to these 18 points by least-squares on each sub-interval, using round() to produce integers. The coefficients are tuned by hand to match the training data.
